title: Retrospective Systematic Hypophysitis Information Network
summary: This multicenter retrospective study (“RetroH”) will analyze routine clinical data from patients with hypophysitis. Hypophysitis is an inflammatory disease of the pituitary gland, which can cause hormonal deficiencies and a wide range of symptoms, including life-threatening complications. Since the introduction of checkpoint inhibitors (CPI) in cancer therapy, the number of patients affected by hypophysitis has increased. The aim of the study is to gain a better understanding of the disease course, diagnosis, and treatment by evaluating clinical data. The results are expected to provide a basis for future prospective studies and to improve patient care.

interventions.name: Patients with hypophysitis - retrospective collection of routine clinical data
